handoffPurpose: Record the mobile class-picker responsive layout fix after a Discord tester reported the game was still not responsive on phone.
currentUserGoal: Fix the mobile responsiveness problem shown in the Discord screenshot, then commit, push, deploy to Vercel, and sync the Mac mini.

workCompletedThisSession.summary: Made the first-run class picker use a dedicated compact phone layout.
details: Reduced narrow-screen panel margins and header/footer spacing so all four class cards plus Back fit inside short phone viewports.
Changed phone card layout to a row-style composition with icon on the left, class text in the middle, and the Start button on the right.
Hid long body/stat copy on phone cards to prevent text from colliding with Start buttons.
Restored class body visibility when the layout returns to non-phone widths so resize/rotation does not leave desktop cards missing details.

verificationPerformed.result: Passed. TypeScript and Vite production build completed successfully.

knownIssuesAndCaveats: This fix addresses the mobile first-run class picker responsiveness shown by the tester screenshot. It does not change the big-field gameplay renderer or skill-menu performance path.
Phone class cards intentionally omit long body/stat text; the compact card keeps the class name, archetype, passive, icon, and Start button visible.
doNotRevertOrTouchWithoutUserRequest: Do not revert the compact phone class-picker layout unless replacing it with another tested mobile layout.
Do not commit unrelated pre-existing untracked docs/artifacts unless the user explicitly asks.
Do not revert the big-field and skill-tree performance work recorded in earlier 2026-06-22 handoffs.
recommendedNextSteps: Have the Discord tester retry the live site on mobile after deployment.
If they still report responsiveness problems, get the exact device/browser and whether the issue is on the title/class picker, gameplay HUD, skill menu, or another modal.
